name: Ayako
source:
Professional name: Kaori

Ayako lives alone in the city working as an Office Lady. She ended up leaving that job due to issues she had. The story is told from her perspective. Ayako starts working for the sex industry as a hostess or fuuzokujou who goes by the name "Kaori" (same as her younger sister's name) and as her title suggests, she has a bright and cheerful personality. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20060207232233/http://www.aquarium-soft.com/aquarium/iyashite/hansoku.htm]Official Website[/url].]
